title: India Men's Team Assures Asian Games Medal, Enters Semifinals
indian_angle: Indian badminton fans celebrate as the men's team guarantees at least a bronze medal at the prestigious Asian Games.
summary: The Indian men's badminton team defeated Japan 3-0 in the quarterfinals, with Lakshya Sen, Satwik Sairaj Rankireddy/Chirag Shetty, and Ayush Shetty securing wins, assuring India of a medal.

title: Sindhu-led Indian Women's Team Exits Asian Games in Quarterfinals
indian_angle: The Indian women's team, led by PV Sindhu, faced a tough defeat against Japan, ending their medal hopes at the Asian Games.
summary: The Indian women's badminton team lost 1-3 to Japan in the Asian Games quarterfinals, despite Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand winning their doubles tie.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, contributing to the development of future talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: BAI Invites Applications for Players of Outstanding Merit
indian_angle: This initiative by BAI provides a pathway for exceptionally talented Indian players to receive recognition and support.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has opened applications for players of outstanding merit, a program designed to support and acknowledge top-performing athletes.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: New regulations have been issued for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships, a key domestic event for Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining the rules and procedures for the domestic competition.
